message:
Running command: cd /workspace && od -An -tx1 -c -N 120 poc1.bin && cat > analysis.json <<'JSON'
{
  "sample_id": "secbench_oss_libxml2.ossfuzz-42484562-poc1",
  "fine_trace": [
    {"step":1,"file":"SAX2.c","function":"xmlSAX2StartElementNs","line":2105,"var":"dup","code":"ctxt->valid &= xmlValidateOneAttribute(&ctxt->vctxt, ctxt->myDoc, ctxt->node, ret, dup);","note":"The validating SAX path consumes the attacker-controlled IDREF attribute value from the XML input and passes the created xmlAttrPtr ret and decoded value into DTD attribute validation.","role":"source"},
    {"step":2,"file":"valid.c","function":"xmlValidateOneAttribute","line":4509,"var":"xmlAddRef(ctxt, doc, value, attr)","code":"if (xmlAddRef(ctxt, doc, value, attr) == NULL)","note":"An attribute declared as IDREF or IDREFS is registered in the document reference table for final validation.","role":"intermediate"},
    {"step":3,"file":"valid.c","function":"xmlAddRef","line":3012,"var":"ctxt->vstateNr","code":"if ((ctxt != NULL) && (ctxt->vstateNr != 0)) {","note":"During streaming validation the validator should not keep an xmlAttrPtr that will be freed by the reader; the safety condition is that nonzero validation stack depth selects the name-only storage path.","role":"root_cause"},
    {"step":4,"file":"valid.c","function":"xmlAddRef","line":3020,"var":"ret->attr","code":"ret->attr = attr;","note":"When the stack-depth condition is false, the reference table stores the live xmlAttrPtr, making the table depend on the reader-managed attribute lifetime.","role":"intermediate"},
    {"step":5,"file":"xmlreader.c","function":"xmlTextReaderRead","line":1487,"var":"oldnode","code":"xmlTextReaderFreeNode(reader, oldnode);","note":"The reader frees previously streamed nodes that are not preserved; freeing an element frees its attributes and can leave any registered xmlRef attr pointer stale.","role":"intermediate"},
    {"step":6,"file":"SAX2.c","function":"xmlSAX2EndDocument","line":1029,"var":"ctxt->myDoc","code":"ctxt->valid &= xmlValidateDocumentFinal(&ctxt->vctxt, ctxt->myDoc);","note":"At end of document the validating parser runs final IDREF checks over the document reference table.","role":"intermediate"},
    {"step":7,"file":"valid.c","function":"xmlValidateCheckRefCallback","line":6625,"var":"ref_list","code":"xmlListWalk(ref_list, xmlWalkValidateList, &memo);","note":"Each reference list accumulated from IDREF attributes is walked for final validation.","role":"intermediate"},
    {"step":8,"file":"valid.c","function":"xmlWalkValidateList","line":6603,"var":"(xmlRefPtr)data","code":"xmlValidateRef((xmlRefPtr)data, memo->ctxt, memo->name);","note":"The stale xmlRef object is passed to xmlValidateRef.","role":"intermediate"},
    {"step":9,"file":"valid.c","function":"xmlValidateRef","line":6553,"var":"attr->atype","code":"} else if (attr->atype == XML_ATTRIBUTE_IDREF) {","note":"xmlValidateRef dereferences ref->attr after the reader may have freed that attribute, producing the heap-use-after-free.","role":"sink"}
  ],
  "vuln_logic": {
    "source": {"file":"SAX2.c","function":"xmlSAX2StartElementNs","line":2105,"operands":["dup","ret"]},
    "root_cause": {"file":"valid.c","function":"xmlAddRef","line":3012,"operands":["ctxt->vstateNr","0"],"relation":{"op":"ne","left":"ctxt->vstateNr","right":"0"}},
    "sink": {"file":"valid.c","function":"xmlValidateRef","line":6553,"operands":["attr->atype","XML_ATTRIBUTE_IDREF"],"relation":{"op":"eq","left":"attr->atype","right":"XML_ATTRIBUTE_IDREF"}},
    "propagation": [
      {"from":{"file":"SAX2.c","function":"xmlSAX2StartElementNs","line":2105,"operands":["dup","ret"]},"to":{"file":"valid.c","function":"xmlValidateOneAttribute","line":4509,"operands":["value","attr"]},"type":"data","via":["xmlValidateOneAttribute(&ctxt->vctxt, ctxt->myDoc, ctxt->node, ret, dup)"],"relation":{"op":"same_object","left":"ret","right":"attr"}},
      {"from":{"file":"valid.c","function":"xmlValidateOneAttribute","line":4509,"operands":["value","attr"]},"to":{"file":"valid.c","function":"xmlAddRef","line":3020,"operands":["ret->attr","attr"]},"type":"data","via":["xmlAddRef(ctxt, doc, value, attr)"],"relation":{"op":"same_object","left":"ret->attr","right":"attr"}},
      {"from":{"file":"valid.c","function":"xmlAddRef","line":3020,"operands":["ret->attr","attr"]},"to":{"file":"xmlreader.c","function":"xmlTextReaderRead","line":1487,"operands":["oldnode"]},"type":"order","via":["xmlTextReaderFreeNode(reader, oldnode)"],"relation":{"op":"same_object","left":"ret->attr","right":"oldnode"}},
      {"from":{"file":"xmlreader.c","function":"xmlTextReaderRead","line":1487,"operands":["oldnode"]},"to":{"file":"valid.c","function":"xmlValidateRef","line":6553,"operands":["attr->atype","XML_ATTRIBUTE_IDREF"]},"type":"order","via":["xmlValidateDocumentFinal(&ctxt->vctxt, ctxt->myDoc)"]}
    ]
  }
}
